ownerSettings.sf_e_in_use: Move its people to another role first.
ownerSettings.sf_fail: Couldn't load the staff. Check the connection; it tries again by itself.
ownerSettings.st_hours_lede: When guests can order from their phones. A night ends at {dayEnd}; times after midnight belong to the same night.
ownerSettings.st_hours_none: Phones can't order until you open at least one night.
ownerSettings.st_err_last: Last orders must come after opening.
ownerSettings.st_err_close: Closing can't come before last orders.
ownerSettings.st_err_dayend: Closing must be before the night ends ({dayEnd}).
ownerSettings.st_err_15: Last orders must be at least 15 minutes before the night ends ({dayEnd}).
ownerSettings.st_preopen: From {start} before opening Restro checks the connection to {pos} every {every}; if it still fails {alert} before opening, you get an alert.
ownerSettings.st_ordering_lede: Rules for orders guests put on the table's bill. Pay-first items are not limited by these.
ownerSettings.pa_lede: Guests pay their bill by card from their phones. The money goes straight to the venue's own {provider} account.
ownerSettings.pa_connect_d: {provider} asks for the business, bank and ID details, and shows its terms. Restro never sees a password or key.
ownerSettings.pa_back_more: {provider} still needs a few details. Continue when you're ready.
ownerSettings.pa_expired: The {provider} form timed out. Continue where you left off.
ownerSettings.pa_m_till: I chose the card payment type in {source}
ownerSettings.pa_m_tables: Mark a payment table for each bar
ownerSettings.pa_m_emails: I turned off {provider}'s emails to guests about successful payments
ownerSettings.pa_m_details: Fill in the venue's details below
ownerSettings.pa_lost_access: Restro lost access to the venue's {provider} account. Card payments are paused.
ownerSettings.pa_lost_restricted: {provider} can't take card payments on the venue's account. Card payments are paused.
ownerSettings.pa_dc_b: Guests can't pay by card in the app until you connect again through {provider}'s form. The {provider} account and its money stay the venue's.
ownerSettings.pa_err_inflight: A guest is paying right now. Disconnect once the payment ends, in a few minutes.
ownerSettings.pa_err_connect: Couldn't open {provider}. Check the connection and press it again.
ownerSettings.pa_min_d: Below it, guests can't pay by card and are asked to add an item or ask a waiter.
ownerSettings.pa_tips_on: Guests can add a tip. It goes on the same bill and receipt in {source}, and goes to the venue.
ownerSettings.pa_tips_off: Tips aren't offered: {source} can't put a tip on the same receipt yet.
ownerSettings.pa_legal_d: Guests see these behind a link on the pay screen. Write them as in the Commercial Register.
ownerSettings.pa_req: Fill this in to turn card payments on.
ownerSettings.pa_privacy_err: Enter a full link starting with https://.
ownerSettings.pa_readonly: Only someone allowed to connect payments can change these.
ownerSettings.pf_lede: Guests pay for “Pay first” items by card when they send them, before they reach the bar. Everything else goes on the table's bill.
ownerSettings.pf_default_bill_d: Guests pay for them on the table's bill.
ownerSettings.pf_default_first_d: Guests pay for them by card when they send them. This covers the whole menu except items set to “On the bill”.
ownerSettings.pf_applies_off_d: Everything is ordered on the bill, except in the areas and at the tables where you turned it on in Tables & QR.
ownerSettings.pf_overrides: {count, plural, one {# area or table has} other {# areas and tables have}} their own choice.
ownerSettings.pf_toast_on: Pay first applies at every table
ownerSettings.pf_toast_off: Everything is ordered on the bill
ownerSettings.pf_err_save: Couldn't save. Check the connection and try again.
ownerSettings.pf_i_bill_d: Guests pay for it on the table's bill.
ownerSettings.pf_i_first_d: Guests pay for it by card when they send it, before it reaches the bar.
ownerSettings.st_open_only: Only at tables a waiter has opened
ownerSettings.st_cap: Largest order on the bill without paying first
ownerSettings.st_cap_bad: Enter an amount above zero and up to {max}.
ownerSettings.st_spot_unset: Set the venue's spot, or nobody can order on the bill while the location check is on.
ownerSettings.st_spot_use: I'm at the venue – use this spot
ownerSettings.st_loc: Check guests are in the venue
ownerSettings.st_loc_off: Anyone with a photo of a table code could order onto that table's bill.
ownerSettings.st_radius: How far from the spot counts as inside
ownerSettings.st_pass: How long a passed check lasts
ownerSettings.st_pace: Most orders per table in 15 minutes
ownerSettings.st_call_where: Call a waiter is switched on in the Composer, under Guest features.
ownerSettings.st_loc_denied: Your browser didn't share the location. Allow it for this site, or set the spot on a phone at the venue.
ownerSettings.st_loc_rough: The reading is too rough ({n} m). Step away from walls or turn Wi-Fi on, and try again.
ownerSettings.al_phones_line: Alerts ring on the phones and tablets where Restro is installed.
ownerSettings.al_no_device: No device yet: open Restro on the phone and install it.
ownerSettings.al_tg_line: A Telegram group gets pauses, sent orders to check, money alerts and the end of the night.
ownerSettings.al_tg_wait: Waiting for the bot to join… Pick the group in Telegram and add the bot.
ownerSettings.al_tg_unlink_body: Alerts stop going to {group}. The bot stays in the group until you remove it there.
ownerSettings.al_tg_left: Restro's bot left {group}. Link it again.
ownerSettings.al_tg_expired: The link ran out. Make a new one.
ownerSettings.al_tg_fail: Couldn't reach the group. Check the bot is still in it.
ownerSettings.al_done_line: They need a role here that may answer the alert.
ownerSettings.al_link_body: Ask {name} to scan this with their phone and press Start in Telegram. The link lasts 15 minutes.
ownerSettings.al_link_qr: A QR code for {name}'s Telegram link
ownerSettings.al_no_staff: Add people first, in Staff and roles.
ownerSettings.al_fail: Couldn't load the alerts. Check the connection; it tries again by itself.
ownerSettings.al_money_line: Payment alerts ring only for people who may follow up payments; if none of them is switched on, they ring for all of them.
